PagerDuty Bot: URGENT: Pager triggered for service=search-api, symptom=~20% 5xxs from canary namespace. Priority=P1. Pager oncall: @Maya

Maya (eng-oncall): got the page, looking now. seeing 502s from canary pods. rolling requests -> canary only. kicking off initial triage. @Sahil can you check registry/manifest?

Sahil (eng-infra): on it. quick glance at registry shows the canary manifest references image: ghcr.io/redwood/search-api:v1.2.3-stale-cache. That tag was retagged yesterday by a flaky CI job. possible cache-poison.

Maya (eng-oncall): oh. that explains mismatch. any evicted layers or digest mismatches?

Sahil (eng-infra): running `skopeo inspect docker://ghcr.io/redwood/search-api:v1.2.3-stale-cache` -> digest = sha256:aa11... different from canary's expected sha256:bb22...

Leah (eng-sre): traffic heatmap shows errors spike at 15:22 UTC when canary started receiving traffic. Canary pods fail at request body decode; looks like mismatched binary (protobuf) schema. Error snippet from pod logs: ```ERROR decoding request: unknown field id=12```

Owen (eng-releases): that tag was supposed to be immutable. CI pipeline mutated v1.2.3-stale-cache to push a debug image. pipeline change PR merged last night. I just reverted the pipeline but tag already retagged.

Maya (eng-oncall): customer impact? Leah?

Leah (eng-sre): 5xxs for ~18% of search traffic (canary ring) — customers hitting canary users (beta group) see failures. No full-prod blast yet but risk if routing expands.

Maya (eng-oncall): assign mitigation: 1) remove canary from load balancer, 2) flip feature flag to disable new-search for beta, 3) rollback manifest to digest or promote a safe tag. I'll start LB cut.

Maya (eng-oncall): `kubectl -n prod patch svc search-lb -p '{"spec":{"sessionAffinity":"None"}}'` (placeholder, doing canary weight -> 0). done — routing away from canary. confirming 5xx rate dropping?

Leah (eng-sre): verified: errors drop to normal within 30s of cut. Good. Customer impact contained.

Maya (eng-oncall): Owen, can you toggle the feature flag kill-switch for beta? Feature: new-search. Endpoint is internal: `POST https://flags.redwood.local/toggle`

Owen (eng-releases): doing it now. `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -d '{"feature":"new-search","env":"beta","state":"off"}' https://flags.redwood.local/toggle` -> 200 OK. Flag off.

CI Bot: Deploy pipeline detected mutable tag usage: job=ci-build-4573, action=push -> warning emitted at 15:10 UTC.

Sahil (eng-infra): next steps: we should never point to mutable tags in manifests. I'll roll the canary manifest to a fixed digest that matches v1.2.3-stable (sha256:cc33...) or rebuild a correct image and promote. We should also revoke write perms that allowed retagging.

Owen (eng-releases): I can prepare a safe canary manifest referencing digest. Which digest to use? We have last-known-good digest sha256:cc33... from release 1.2.2-stable.

Leah (eng-sre): prefer to promote a new build with the intended commit instead of reusing older digest if behavior changes matter. But for immediate recovery, pin to cc33 to unblock.

Maya (eng-oncall): agree. Let's pin for now to unblock. Owen, patch the deployment to use digest. Use `kubectl set image` with digest.

Owen (eng-releases): running: `kubectl -n canary set image deploy/search-canary search-api=ghcr.io/redwood/search-api@sha256:cc33... --record` -> rollout started

Deploy Bot: rollout started for deployment/search-canary; newreplicas=3

Leah (eng-sre): monitoring logs/metrics. healthchecks passing on new pods. No more decode errors.

Maya (eng-oncall): once healthy, re-enable small traffic to canary and observe for 10m before promoting. But do not expand rings.

Sahil (eng-infra): I'm also going to lock mutable-tags in the registry: ACL change -> removing `ci-pusher` write perms for `v*` tags. Will coordinate with CI team.

Owen (eng-releases): quick postmortem notes: root cause = CI pipeline allowed retagging of semver-like tag `v1.2.3-stale-cache` -> registry mutation -> canary manifest still pointed to tag. Mitigation = pin to digest, roll LB back, kill feature flag. Next actions: enforce immutability, add digest pinning lint in CD, add CI job to block mutable-tag pushes.

Maya (eng-oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. @Sahil please own registry ACL change. @Owen own manifest pin PR & verification. @Leah keep an eye on alerts for 1h. I'll document customer impact and severity.

PagerDuty Bot: Incident summary created: INC-2023-4572, severity=SEV2, impacted=beta search users (~18% of requests), mitigation=canary cut + feature flag off + pinned manifest. Assigned to: Maya, Sahil, Owen, Leah.

Maya (eng-oncall): customer comms? Product suggested an FYI to beta customers. I'll draft a short note: apology, cause (registry retag), impact (beta users saw errors), mitigation (canary cut, flag off), ETA for fix (registry ACL + durable tag policy ~24h).

Owen (eng-releases): PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/PR-789 -> pins canary to digest; CI change PR opening next.

Sahil (eng-infra): registry ACL change applied (revoked push on semver tags), tests green. I'm adding a follow-up ticket to rotate any mutable tag exposures.

Leah (eng-sre): monitoring 30m post-mitigation: no regression, 5xxs stable. Will keep under watch.

Maya (eng-oncall): ok handing off. Leaving notes in INC-2023-4572. If anything spikes, page me. thanks team :heart:

Owen (eng-releases): thanks all.

CI Bot: Note: schedule backfill job to rebuild the accidentally retagged image to prevent future ambiguity.
